name: Hong Leong Financial Group Berhad

source.title: Hong Leong Financial quarterly report Q4 FY2026

oneLine: The holding company of Hong Leong Bank, Hong Leong Assurance and Hong Leong Capital.
inPlainWords: HLFG owns about 64% of Hong Leong Bank, which earns most of its profit.
It also owns insurer Hong Leong Assurance and investment bank Hong Leong Capital.
Because it owns only part of the bank, about a third of group profit belongs to minority shareholders.
Its shares usually trade at a discount to the value of the companies it owns.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Commercial banking (Hong Leong Bank)
segments.desc: Banking in Malaysia and abroad, including the China associate

segments.name: Investment banking (Hong Leong Capital)
segments.desc: Stockbroking, fund management and deal advice

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q4 FY2026 report p.11). Other operations and inter-segment eliminations are left out.

aiImages.caption: Deposits: savers' money kept safe and paid a return

Loans: money lent so homes, cars and businesses can grow
